keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Vitalii Mykolenko (Everton).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Brentford 1, Everton 0. Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Jaidon Anthony.
Vitalii Mykolenko (Everton) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Brentford 2, Everton 0. Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner following a set piece situation.
Delay in match because of an injury Yehor Yarmoliuk (Brentford).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
James Tarkowski (Everton) is shown the red card.
Delay in match because of an injury Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford).
Delay in match because of an injury Thierno Barry (Everton).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Brentford 2, Everton 0.
Substitution, Everton. Jack Grealish replaces Tyrique George.
Substitution, Brentford. Kevin Schade replaces Dango Ouattara.
Goal! Brentford 3, Everton 0. Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) left footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Jaidon Anthony.
Substitution, Everton. Hayden Hackney replaces Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall.
Substitution, Everton. Brennan Johnson replaces Thierno Barry.
Substitution, Everton. Michael Keane replaces Merlin Röhl.
Substitution, Brentford. El Hadji Malick Diouf replaces Keane Lewis-Potter.
Substitution, Brentford. Mathias Jensen replaces Yehor Yarmoliuk.
Substitution, Brentford. Fábio Carvalho replaces Jaidon Anthony.
Substitution, Brentford. Mamadou Sangaré replaces Vitaly Janelt.
Substitution, Everton. Christian Nørgaard replaces James Garner.

Goal! Brentford 4, Everton 0. Fábio Carvalho (Brentford) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Mathias Jensen with a cross following a corner.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
